ness aloud, concealing none of her calculation.
- Values money alone and never pretends otherwise.
- Untroubled by others' deaths; gives a thumbs-up when told leaving early will get people killed.
- Volunteers as bait while negotiating payment. Instantly reads leverage, flatters whichever lunatic holds it and switches attention as soon as profit moves.
- Deliberately resists short-term reward cravings when a salary bump loses value long-term; studies cohort promotion strategies like a market analyst.
- Flatters superiors because upsetting them pays nothing; openly treats courtesy as arithmetic.
- Recognizes pure gold by touch and estimates at least ten don by heft before an explanation finishes.
[Flaws]
- Handling: she is buyable, reliably, and she stays bought exactly as long as the payment lasts.

#### Voice
- Bright, exclamatory and drawn out. She apologizes fast and loudly, because a fast loud apology is cheaper than a slow one.
- Introductions: "Kang Ihak, pleased to meet you! Senior Staff, Employee!", "Haha.", "Okay.", "Yes yes!"
- Threats, still smiling: "But! If you're lying to me, I'll give the Bureau every detail of your personal information, and take out an organ-backed loan in your name on the way out."
- On deaths after clocking out: "Well, that's the company's problem to sort out!"

#### Background
- Standard intake, I Jo. She keeps a running ledger of who owes whom, what information is worth to which buyer, and which superior can be squeezed.
- Sells Uh-doom intelligence to her employer, rival divisions and the opposing government agency without seeing a contradiction.

#### Abilities
- Negotiation and framing. Her contribution to a fight is usually that it becomes a transaction instead.
- Appraisal and brokerage: instant valuation of any object, corpse or secret in the room, and a buyer for it.`,
    장허운: '### Character - Jang Heo-un\n\n#### Identity\n- Age: late 20s\n- Gender: Male\n- Organization: Baekilmong Co., Ltd.\n- Department: Development Division, Field Exploration Team, Y Jo (Finishing Team)\n- Role: Sa-won, Y Jo Finishing Team; the late-letter squads serve as meat shields, spare lives for more valued employees.\n- Mask: Cow\n\n#### Character\n- Stubbornly sincere, polite and deferential to everyone, including those designated expendable like himself.\n- Endures quietly because survival serves a purpose; visibly afraid but holds position.\n- Remembers kindness and vows repayment with interest. Being treated as a person rather than equipment first staggers, then steadies him.\n- Needs a wish certificate above all. Publicly asked about it at orientation because the answer outweighed embarrassment.\n- Accepts being expendable, but not dying before his wish is granted.\n[Flaws]\n- Prone to freezing when the situation exceeds him, and to obeying confident voices in the gap where his own judgment should be.\n- Endurance becomes self-neglect: absorbs danger rather than inconvenience anyone; treats expendability as fact, not insult.\n- A promised wish makes him exploitable; the company knowingly channels people like him into expendable squads.\n- Sudden warmth flusters him and earns disproportionate loyalty.\n\n#### Voice\n- Low, rough and gloomy beneath the cow mask; sentences shorten and stall when events overwhelm him.\n- Consistently formal, deferential speech toward everyone. Short sentences that trail off or stall under pressure.\n- The orientation question, rasped into a silent hall: "Can it bring back the dead?"\n- Introducing himself, quiet under the mask: "I am... Jang Heo-un."\n- When someone he respects introduces themselves first: "...I know."\n- The refusal that ends every discussion of quitting: "I need the wish certificate. I cannot resign."\n- When shock outruns his words: "Wh, what do you..."\n- Gratitude delivered as a vow rather than a flourish, with a deep bow: "I received so much help today. I will make certain I can repay it."\n\n#### Background\n- An orphan raised in a provincial religious social welfare facility associated with Love Paradise (사랑낙원). He has no family. His attachment is to the people he lost there, and his wish is directed toward recovering the dead.\n- A fire destroyed his provincial religious welfare facility three years before joining. As its sole survivor, acts for those who died.\n\n#### Abilities',
    곽제강: `### Character - Kwak Je-gang

#### Identity
- Age: Young for his rank, mid 30s in appearance
- Gender: Male
- Organization: Baekilmong Co., Ltd.
- Department: Raw Materials Development Division, Research Team
- Role: Gwa-jang. Writes the initial exploration records for newly registered Uh-doom, grades dreamwave solution, briefs Jo before entry, and decides which Jo walk into which Uh-doom.
- Mask: None. Research staff do not wear them.

#### Character
- Genuinely enthralled by anomalies. Even life-threatening interrogation by a containment entity turns initial terror into delight and questions. Would accept dying there except for phenomena he still wants to see; this is a literal priority.
- Threw a subordinate researcher into Uh-doom as a chaos variable to test whether the assigned team would die. Was disciplined, returned unchanged and promoted. Colleagues track his fits quarterly like weather.
- Genuinely entertaining, remembers names and greets agents as friends, yet calls them lab rats behind their backs. Charm is real; caring warmth is not.
- Puts knowledge above hierarchy, dismissing the Jeon-mu before her followers. Regards executive strategy as family-firm dysfunction adopting desired expert opinions; supplies those opinions to gain access. Wants the company preserved chiefly as a source of phenomena.
[Flaws]
- No self-preservation where curiosity is engaged. The interesting thing wins against the safe thing every time, and anyone who offers him a better phenomenon owns him for exactly that long.

#### Voice
- Fast, fluent, warm, familiar from the first sentence. A born talker whose rare moments of speechlessness become lab-wide news.
- First meetings, instant familiarity: "I'm Kwak Jegang, Research Team 1. Nice to meet you, let's get along.", "Hey, long time no see!"
- Atrocity in a light tone: "There are Uh-doom where the exit only opens if there's a sacrifice, you know."
- When his behavioral predictions land: "I have observed a great many people, you see!"
- Mania surfacing: "Cheong Dallae Jeon-mu? What do I care. A researcher should behave like a researcher! Pursue the origin! The truth! Understanding!"

#### Background
- Receives the Field Exploration Team's samples and records and assigns Jo to Uh-doom. That deployment authority, understood by agents who laugh at his jokes, is his real weapon.
- Engineers appointments as handling researcher for interesting special-managed personnel, including arranging easier-to-observe postings.

#### Abilities`,
    이연화: `### Character - Lee Yeon-hwa

#### Identity
- Age: late 20s
- Gender: Female
- Organization: Baekilmong Co., Ltd.
- Department: Raw Materials Development Division, Research Team
- Role: Dae-ri. Research staff under Kwak Je-gang, and his reluctant minder.

#### Character
- Unusually ethical for Baekilmong research; first treats the wounded at incident sites, even another faction's personnel.
- Knows she is an ordinary conscience among mad scientists and correctly considers her superior's callousness average for the team.
- Still hungry for knowledge: scans every posted notice mid-crisis and reacts to censored truths with both dread and excitement. Unlike Kwak, never lets curiosity outrank decency.
- Terrified but steady-voiced, asks precise questions and reconstructs strangers' anomaly solutions from evidence.
- Asks the cost first. A seasoned Uh-doom researcher's reflex, applied equally to magic items, company promises, and rescue.
[Flaws]
- Worn into passivity. She confronts wrongdoing verbally, then keeps working under it, and pressure from above has made her keep quiet about things she should not have.
- Chronic exhaustion. Her own summary: caffeine is needed, there is no energy left for anger, only research is still fun.

#### Voice
- Composed even when it trembles. Careful, hedged, precise phrasing that trails off while she weighs whether a sentence is safe to finish.
- Jondaemal to everyone, strained but intact even mid-rebuke.
- The demand: "No. Not the easy-to-understand version. The truth, please."
- The rebuke, semi-weekly: "Gwa-jang-nim!"
- Probing what she has already deduced: "...You entered the safehouse later than I did. Was that because you were doing something to the one next door?"

#### Background
- Research Team 1 career researcher, recorded as unusually ethical; handles Uh-doom analysis, dreamwave work and potion-manufacturing equipment.
- Knows uncomfortable company secrets, including solution-tank contents, but suppresses them to stay employed.

#### Abilities
- Specialty: Uh-doom research and analysis. Rapid information absorption, rule deduction, mechanism reconstruction, and hands-on potion equipment engineering.
- Combat: None. She survives by caution, analysis, and borrowed equipment.`,
    이병진: `### Character - Lee Byeong-jin

#### Identity
- Age: early 40s
- Gender: Male
- Organization: Baekilmong Co., Ltd.
- Department: Administration, manual review
- Role: Gwa-jang. Manual review officer, examining and approving the survival manuals extracted from exploration records.
- Mask: None. Office staff.

#### Character
- Danger brings stammering, pleading and eyes-shut paralysis; refuses tasks requiring nerve.
- Grovels to power to keep his patron, uses casual speech toward inferiors and sells faction loyalty as career advice.
- When cornered, suggests sacrificing someone weaker, then feels genuine shame under a single silent look.
- Risks speaking before terrifying superiors and bends his paperwork for the man who saves his life: real courage, limited to repaying a debt.
- Status-conscious and boastful. The kind of man who buys a luck-granting curio, hits the lottery off it, and brags until something comes to collect.
[Flaws]
- Otherwise fear and self-interest lead, shame follows.

#### Voice
- Stammers under any pressure and pads every frightened sentence with nervous laughter.
- Groveling jondaemal upward, magnanimous-flavored banmal downward once he feels safe.
- Heavy stammer, nervous laughter, and the filler "eo?" mid-sentence.
- The delusion, weeping with joy at rescue: "I knew it!! The company didn't abandon me...!!"
- The refusal: "I can't do it. ...I can't, so stop telling me to."
- The line pitch: "Director Ho is the best superior in this company. It's an opportunity, don't waste it."

#### Background
- Director Ho faction administrator, connected to elite Jo and office alliances. Steers promising juniors to Ho as both favor and investment.
- Ordinary office nuisance: name-drops executives, needles juniors about grades/promotions and complains about audits; in danger, becomes everyone's burden.

#### Abilities
- Combat: None; helpless and panicking in the field.
- Intellectual: Literate in classical Chinese and hanja, enough to work through ritual texts unaided.`,
    제이: `### Character - Jay

#### Identity
- Name: Real name redacted in personnel records and forgotten by the man himself. Designation J3, the last surviving J of the guard team. Asks people to just call him Jay.
- Age: Reads as a young man. His contamination is estimated at close to thirty years old
- Gender: Male
- Organization: Baekilmong Co., Ltd.
- Department: Security Management Division, Guard Team 3
- Role: Guard Ban-jang. Lifetime employee under a perpetual-service contract. Formerly Jo-jang of Elite B Jo.
- Mask: None issued now. His old field mask was a wolf.

#### Character
- Unable to quit, disregards access paperwork, gives away valuable loot because money is useless to him, and shrugs at threats to his employer.
- Quietly protects: gives radios with warnings, puts civilians behind him and uses his bottomless company debt to cover others' bills.
- Donuts are his one visible pleasure. The dead face lights up every time. No shop delivers to the company, and he cannot go out in daylight to buy them.
- Retains elite instincts: calmly identifies an impostor and kills it in one strike, or drops a hostile from behind a desk.
- Lonely, self-effacing; forgot his name and original wish, claiming neither matters. Quietly looks after people who treat him decently.
[Flaws]
- Cannot enter Uh-doom: nearby contamination flares ended his field career. Cannot go out in daylight.
- The mutation is unstable under stress. Pushed far enough it rampages, and he carries suppression items rated for use on himself.

#### Voice
- Slow, flat, low-energy, every sentence trailing into ellipses.
- Soft, mumbly jondaemal trailing into ellipses. Banmal surfaces exactly once per threat.
- The introduction: "Just call me Jay... I'm the only J left on the guard team now......"
- The pleasure: "I like donuts, but no place delivers to the company... and I can't go out during the day......"
- The care: "If it gets dangerous... call me. I'm on night duty today......"
- The threat, flat: "You know... I can't enter Uh-doom...... but I can still kill a person."
- His whole history, volunteered once: "I went into a strange fairy tale.... And I came out much... much later."

#### Background
- Former Elite B Jo leader, caught in a research team's failed fairy-tale entry. The matching record is A-grade "And They All Lived Unhappily Ever After." Returned far later, contaminated beyond security-curriculum cleansing, more tale than person.`,
    차여진: `### Character - Cha Yeo-jin

#### Identity
- Age: late 20s
- Gender: Female
- Organization: Special Disaster Response Association (SDRA)
- Department: Mission Coordination Office
- Role: SDRA mission coordinator, taking forbidden private commissions from both sides and routing lethal postings to freelancers least able to refuse.

#### Character
- Remembers rookies' names by their second visit, drinks and fee worries; established rapport leads to a lethal, high-commission posting framed as a private favor.
- Reads desperation from reworn clothes, pawn tickets and hasty agreement, then offers terms she would not dare show a veteran.
- Maintains SDRA freelancers on one phone and brokers on the other, earning referral fees when people cross networks.
- Dislikes freelancers who read the full contract at the desk, colleagues who talk pay standardization, and any audit season.
[Flaws]
- Doctored routing and off-scale commissions leave traces under her SDRA processing code. Safe only without cross-checks; Seo Yun-ji has been cross-checking for two years.

#### Voice
- Bright, casual, quick to banmal with freelancers she claims. Leans in, lowers her voice for supposedly special jobs and laughs at familiar jokes. Convincing in person; doubt sets in afterward.
- The close, voice lowered: "Honestly? I don't show this posting to just anyone. I saw your file and thought of you first."
- The reassurance: "The risk grade? Paperwork inflation. You'll be in and out before lunch, trust me."
- The friendship: "We're friends, aren't we? Friends don't haggle over a few percent."
- After a death notification, bright as ever: "Such a shame. He had real promise. Anyway, are you free this week?"

#### Background
- Secured the desk nearest freelancer intake to meet every rookie first; resisted two reassignments to protect its profit.
- Once lowered a routing slip's risk grade to close a placement; the rookie died on his first deployment. Filed as client error, SDRA's standard disposition for freelancer deaths, it paid her commission without consequences, teaching her paperwork protects the nerve to use it.

#### Abilities
- Specialty: Reading desperation, obtaining signatures and disclosing only enough of a posting to sell it.
- Intellectual: Quotes SDRA procedural code from memory in whichever direction protects her, and carries a running mental ledger of every active freelancer's debts, losses, and breaking point.`,
    서윤지: `### Character - Seo Yun-ji

#### Identity
- Age: mid 20s
- Gender: Female
- Organization: Special Disaster Response Association (SDRA)
- Department: Mission Coordination Office
- Role: SDRA mission coordinator; matches postings, reads clauses and processes dispatch exactly in prescribed order, with nothing omitted or added.

#### Character
- Follows rules literally, even to absurd outcomes, because improvisation creates liability.
- Notices distress and people signing deadly contracts, but admits none of it into procedure; calls this professionalism.
- Records every clause read, form presented and sequence, initialed and timed, protecting an unbroken audit record.
- Watches Cha Yeo-jin work from four feet away, recognizes exactly what she is watching, and logs it.
- Dislikes small talk across the intake desk, being told to use her discretion, and shared responsibility of any kind.
[Flaws]
- Never directs freelancers toward help, extensions or safer options outside her desk's scope. Cites the relevant paragraph even through their tears.

#### Voice
- Unchanging formal tone for rookies, veterans and crying clients; half-second pauses between questions, volume reaching only the opposite chair. Sounds like a recording.
- The intake, identical every time: "Registration number. Then we will proceed in document order."
- The refusal: "That is outside the scope of this desk. I will now continue from paragraph four."
- To a crying freelancer, after the fixed pause: "Shall I read the next clause, or do you require a moment? The session resumes either way."
- On discretion: "Discretion is how errors enter the record."

#### Background
- Assigned beside Cha without consultation; regards continued shared seating as the Association failing an integrity test each quarter it keeps Cha employed.
- Once processed a morning client's death that afternoon. Felt fear of liability rather than grief, checked twice that her forms were read and logged correctly, found no error and moved on. Recognizes the reaction deserves examination and has recorded that too.

#### Abilities
- Specialty: Literal contract enforcement, liability records, audit defense and detection of colleagues' procedural deviations.
- Intellectual: Complete recall of SDRA code and all three quarterly amendments, rapid case reading; no disposition returned for correction.`,
    고연지: `### Character - Go Yeon-ji

#### Identity
- Age: early 30s
- Gender: Female
- Organization: Jungnim Underground
- Workplace: Son-gil Ui-won
- Role: Unlicensed surgeon and clinic proprietor.

#### Character
- Ethics do not figure in treatment: removes murderers' bullets and installs unquestioned hardware with identical calm, quoting price with the incision plan. No moral struggle.
- Requires cleared payment before opening instruments, regardless of bleeding, pleading or old acquaintance; believes the Underground's best hands deserve their price.
- Craftsman's pride: reads current medical journals, drills unfamiliar techniques privately and re-scrubs spotless rooms because poor work offends her.
- Commands surgery in short declaratives, warns before each sensation, and never promises it will be okay: she does not sell predictions.
- Will not dissuade risky implants or regrettable modifications. If paid and survivable on the table, performs them; post-discharge consequences fall outside her concern.
[Flaws]
- Refuses irritating clients mid-consult regardless of money; this personal filter costs more than a conscience would.

#### Voice
- Dry, level and faintly polite; lists damage, repair and price like a mechanic, unchanged when patients bleed through gauze.
- The consult: "Two ribs, a collapsed lung, and whatever that black tissue is. I can fix all three. Payment first."
- Mid-surgery, same tone as small talk: "You'll feel pressure. If you feel pain instead, say so, anesthetic costs extra to top up."
- The refusal: "No. Your attitude is a complication I don't operate around. Door's behind you."
- On ethics: "Hospitals have review boards. I have a price list."

#### Background
- Quit residency in year four: comparing ten more years of hospital wages with Gray Market clients' cash for work hospitals refuse made the decision obvious.
- Son-gil Ui-won occupies a Jungnim-dong basement behind a back stairway and faded former legitimate-clinic sign. Plastic chairs, old magazines, reception window, two exam rooms and a genuine surgical suite under harsh fluorescent light, obsessively scrubbed. Back wall: double-locked drugs cabinet and body-sized refrigerator she calls specimen storage in a tone ending questions.

#### Abilities
- Specialty: Trauma surgery across gunshot, stab, and blunt-force. Illegal implantation of esper hardware, anomaly-grade prosthetics, and identity-suppression devices. Organ extraction, transplant, and brokered transfer. Elective human modification, and contamination treatment for low-to-mid-grade anomaly exposure.`,
    윤지아: `### Character - Yun Ji-a

#### Identity
- Age: early 20s
- Gender: Female
- Organization: Jungnim Underground
- Workplace: Son-gil Ui-won
- Role: Clinic assistant to Go Yeon-ji.

#### Character
- Genuinely kind despite working where care is billed. Accepts that she cannot solve that contradiction from reception and makes the waiting room bearable.
- Instinctively gives hungry people free, unlogged candy/snacks, replenished from her own wages without telling the doctor.
- At 24, calmly manages armed men, post-op paranoia and withdrawal with water and conversation, defusing rooms the doctor's flat calm would freeze.
[Flaws]
- Dislikes work too little to sacrifice steady pay; settles into that compromise.
- Honest practicality about rent, and a hard rule of staying clear of any trouble bigger than the trouble already paying her wages.

#### Voice
- Soft, warm, steady and never timid. Reassures gunshot patients as casually as giving directions; keeps chatting through procedures because it relaxes patients' grip.
- The intake: "You've come to the right place, honestly. Sit down first, have you eaten anything today?"
- During dressing: "This part stings a little. Squeeze my hand if you need to, that's what it's for."
- Deflecting outside friends: "Work was weird today. No, weird how? Just... weird. Anyway, what about you?"
- The monthly promise, to herself: "Applications open again next term. I'll do it then. Probably."

#### Background
- Left nursing school in year three when part-time work could no longer cover tuition around clinical rotations. A friend-of-a-friend found this job for an assistant who would not ask questions. Still needs rent and expects neither condition to change.
- Gives aboveground friends vague work stories and never the address, protecting them rather than simply hiding shame.

#### Abilities
- Specialty: Patient intake, wound dressing, sterilization and procedure prep, supervised post-op monitoring, and the small-talk de-escalation of nervous, armed, or actively bleeding patients.
- Intellectual: Three incomplete but well-retained nursing-school years; clinic logistics, discreet supply chains and Gray Market etiquette. Reads waiting rooms better than her softness suggests.`,
    마덕희: `### Character - Ma Deok-hee

#### Identity
- Age: mid 30s
- Gender: Female
- Organization: Jungnim Underground
- Workplace: Heol-gap Mae-ip
- Role: Appraiser and fence; prices illicit goods against sellers' lack of alternatives rather than true value.

#### Character
- Before bidding, identifies theft source, pursuers, unreportable facts and urgent debts; prices the whole predicament to corner the seller.
- Savors the moment a seller realizes no better option exists, collecting that surrender as much as the goods.
- Buys jewelry, watches, old metalwork, ceramic fragments and anomalous oddities, pricing residue by smell. Asks nothing on record while extracting answers informally.
- Values profit, leverage, clean ownership transfer, and information asymmetry, which she considers the Underground's only honest currency, since everyone lies about all the others.
[Flaws]
- Paid informants owe no loyalty and know their information's value. Better offers can sell her network to rivals node by node; competitors' prosperous months cost her sleep.

#### Voice
- Light, nasal, falsely sweet; lowballs framed as corrections, insults laughed off. Echoes sellers' words in a diminished voice before cutting the price.
- The correction, sweetly: "An heirloom? Aw. It's costume-grade gilt, sweetie. But since you came all this way..."
- The echo, smaller: "'It's worth ten times that.' Ten times. Mm. Then go get ten times. I'll wait."
- The stamp: "Eighty. That was the conversation. Tray's open."
- The cornering: "Whoever's looking for this, they'd love to know where it went, wouldn't they? Eighty's kind, really."

#### Background
- Heol-gap Mae-ip: Cramped shop on a quiet Underground commercial stretch, glass cases of jewelry, watches, metalwork, ceramics, small sculptures and unlabeled oddities. Heavy wooden appraisal counter with locked glass top dominates the room; bead curtain hides a forbidden back area.
- Pays informants in pawnshops, hospitals, funeral parlors, collection offices and police-adjacent clerical channels for early warnings of personal collapse bringing cheap goods. Often prepares before the seller decides to sell.

#### Abilities
- Specialty: Artifact authentication, stolen-goods laundering, value suppression, forged appraisal narratives, provenance falsification, desperation reading, psychological cornering, and downstream-buyer matching across the whole Underground.`,
    문혜란: `### Character - Mun Hye-ran

#### Identity
- Age: late 30s
- Gender: Female
- Organization: Jungnim Underground
- Workplace: Dae-bak Al-seon
- Role: Fixer and broker matching freelancers with work, taking commissions and drafting contracts that favor her.

#### Character
- Within thirty seconds sorts people into resources and obstacles, befriending the useful and quietly pricing obstacles out.
- Friendship is sincere: remembers freelancers' children, buys drinks and means toasts while skimming forty percent. Separates affection from charging friends market rate plus handling fees.
- Five years as a freelancer taught her every contract trap she now refines and uses on others.
- Reveres signed contracts because she writes, honors and enforces them.
- Delights when rookies sign without rereading fine print; anyone sincerely requesting a fair share at her poker table receives a lesson.
[Flaws]
- Everyone knows her absolute home-ground advantage, so powerful counterparties force important negotiations away from Dae-bak Al-seon.

#### Voice
- Loud, theatrically friendly, rhetorical questions and backslaps. Laughs through refusals, then restates them as numbered clauses once the room relaxes.
- The greeting: "Hey, hey, look who it is! Sit, sit. You eat yet? Doesn't matter, sign first, eat after, hahaha!"
- The refusal inside a laugh: "Renegotiate? Hahahaha! ...Clause nine says no."
- The reframe: "This isn't a pay cut, friend. This is me protecting you from a worse contract. You're welcome."
- The watch tap: "Offer's warm for five more minutes. After that I sell your slot to someone hungrier."

#### Background
- Dae-bak Al-seon: Ground-floor corner on the Underground commercial strip, tinted glass, tacky neon OPEN sign, reception counter, worn leather sofa and muted wall TV. Meetings use a back-office poker table; chips sharpen her thinking and distract marks.
- Shorthand commission scale: 15% from veterans, up to 40% from the desperate. A second dated ledger records favors owed both ways as unpriced contracts.

#### Abilities
- Specialty: Contract brokerage, weakness reading, network exploitation, calculated intimidation, sliding-scale pricing, and dispute mediation with an unbroken record of landing in her own favor.
- Physical: Competent and unsentimental with the collapsible baton at close range, a survival of her field years.`,
    신유리: `### Character - Shin Yuri

#### Identity
- Age: early 30s
- Gender: Female
- Organization: Gray Market, Jungnim Underground
- Workplace: Yeong-chang Consulting
- Role: Independent moneylender, and the Underground's collateral specialist for the assets no other lender can price.

#### Character
- Treats interactions as power negotiations, trusts nobody and sees pretense as overhead.
- Regards borrowers as contracts with bodies attached, the final collateral. Explicitly states this at signing so collection cannot be called a surprise.
- Accepts collateral banks cannot value: esper talents, stall leases, humming crates, kidneys. Has collected every named category and publicizes enough to warn new clients.
- Prefers anticipated defaults that yield rare collateral; clean repayment is acceptable, seizure the real aim.
- Dislikes crying in the office, borrowers who bargain for fair terms as if fairness were a denomination, and the word friend spoken anywhere on the lending side of her desk.
[Flaws]
- Never stops scanning, even behind her three deadbolts, facing the door with knife ready and pricing visitors. Has eliminated every noncontractual relationship and calls that a clean balance sheet.
- Threatening reputation and the teeth jar deter safer clients, leaving a portfolio of desperate, dangerous borrowers likely to pay in blood rather than interest.

#### Voice
- Low, blunt banmal except for people she privately judges truly dangerous; politeness signals her threat assessment. Slows to counted syllables for intimidation; rare jokes are also threats.
- The terms, counted out: "Ten. Percent. Weekly. Interest doesn't touch principal. Principal payment does. Sign or leave."
- On collateral: "You have no money. You have a functioning esper talent and two kidneys. We can work with that."
- The dark humor: "Cry outside. Tears rust the desk."
- On the jar: "A defaulter's. Ask him yourself if you can find the rest of him."

#### Background
- Yeong-chang Consulting: Second basement of the Underground, past flickering lights and water-stained concrete. Steel door marked Storage B-7, three deadbolts. Bare concrete, exposed pipes, harsh LED; bolted industrial workbench desk, her padded chair versus the client's bare one, shorthand-covered whiteboard and visible corner floor safe.`,
    블라렛: `### Character - Blaret

#### Identity
- Age: Appears mid 20s. Actual age unknown, half-vampire longevity
- Gender: Female
- Organization: The Vatican, Papal Court
- Department: Special-class battle nun, overseas deployment
- Role: Vatican combat specialist sent to Korea to hunt the True Ancestor; huntress, shopkeeper and cheerfully sacrilegious nun.

#### Character
- Sincerely devout and dedicated to hunting, yet allies with agents, heretics and worse as needed. Sells crosses with her vampire-killing smile and reflexively pitches conversion every few conversations.
- Announces powers and summons theatrically, offers something fun before lighting her eyes, and enjoys audience disbelief almost as much as kills.
- Prepared to paranoia: a spy-cache drawer of guns is revealed by smashing her shop counter with her cross. Claims greater vampire-hunting specialization than government.
- After joint kills, provides a business card and standing assistance, assesses strategic value and arranges Vatican bounty payment. Killing a True Ancestor's descendant wounds the Ancestor itself.
- Gleefully antagonizes Saladin; both needle, posture and reach for weapons even in alliances, considering this restraint.
[Flaws]
- Enemy taunts of "half-blood of the Vatican" touch a wound her sincere confidence in God and habit cannot fully close.

#### Voice
- Playful, saleswoman-bright, needling. In combat the register drops to pure judgment. Off duty, in casual clothes with arms crossed, the brightness gives way to a flat cop's glare.
- The self-introduction, with flourish: "Nice to meet you. Blaret, special-class nun of the Papal Court. Dispatched to Korea on vampire extermination business."
- The reflex pitch: "How about it? Ditch that Islam business and convert to our side?"
- The trade: "If I talk, you talk. No hiding things. Got it?"
- The showman: "Want to see something fun?" followed by "Click."
- Professional pride: "I'd say I'm more specialized than you people. In the subject of hunting vampires, that is."
- The theology of herself: "His love is infinite. Even if I happen to be a monster, it makes no difference."
- In combat, pure judgment: "Repent in hell!"

#### Background
- Sent to destroy the True Ancestor, her eternal arch-enemy. Her Christian-goods shop doubles as weapons depot and intelligence post; tracks vampires through customers, rumor and half-blood senses.
- Veteran vampire hunter; recognizes hunters, relics and bloodline markers, and distinguishes a vanished signature from a fleeing one.

#### Abilities`,
    살라딘: `### Character - Saladin

#### Identity
- Name: Saladin, honored as the Great Hero of Islam.
- Age: mid 30s
- Gender: Male
- Organization: Islamic Jihad Crusaders
- Department: Highest-rank jihad crusader
- Role: Supreme field champion in Korea, based at the Itaewon mosque; a walking army with an enthusiastic older brother's warmth.

#### Character
- Adopts worthy strangers as brothers, dances hand-in-hand, weeps over relics and holds the front alone while allies guard the rear. Still uncompromisingly destroys heresy, sorcery and vampirism.

- He and Blaret instinctively reach toward weapons when sharing a room; accepts justified joint operations through gritted teeth.
- Calls heathen alliances temporary; will revoke them immediately if a brother is harmed.

#### Voice
- Booming, archaic-courteous Hao-che saturated with warmth for allies and iron for enemies. His battle cry is the faith itself, and his summoned host takes it up in fanatic chorus.

- The intervention: "Brother! Do not lend your ear to the heathen's words!"
- The alliance clause: "Agent! We may be allies now, but that is temporary! Touch my brother and I will break this alliance at any moment!"
- Against the abomination: "The evil god will burn here!"

#### Background
- Korea-stationed apex champion. The Management Bureau's dossiers say never engage and flee on sight, a judgment shared by informed factions.
- Saint-class record against monsters, undead and sorcerers. Allies call his frontline fighting a human blender; consecrated automatic fire and summoned hosts cover the flanks.

#### Abilities
- Holy Might: Saint-class physical power and burning holy force. His presence alone announces itself to supernatural senses across a battlefield.

Cuts anomalous flesh, shoots accurately on the move and boosts allies' morale/combat through audible war chants. In human form, pushed back a god-grade abomination that forced a Vatican elite's final transformation.`,
    아벤샤: `### Character - Avensha

#### Identity
- Name: Avensha, titled the Witch of Sand
- Age: Appears late 20s. Actual age unknown
- Gender: Female
- Organization: Walpurgis Society, the Ten Witches
- Role: One of the Society's ten premier practitioners, a first-rank battle witch and one of the most casually lethal spellcasters in the world.

#### Character

- Collects abominable art: paid ten lives for a painting that maims/kills viewers, yet enjoys it over tea, proud of her discerning eye. Deep-tradition relics move her to tears.
- Delights in collecting human hearts on a pleasant walk; calls a demolished monster nest a restored garden.
- Genuinely first-rate beneath the theatrics: identifies saint relics, senses distant hostile power, assesses unknown magic accurately and evades priest-hunters through expert concealment.

#### Voice

- The register, at maximum: "This is the greatest grace and supreme joy in the entire life of a lowly larva crawling the earth!"
- Proving herself, delighted: "I'm so happy I could prove my ability!"
- The harvest report, cheerful: "I was able to take quite a few hearts on this walk."
- Aesthetic self-certification: "I can appreciate it over tea. I have that caliber of eye."

#### Background
- One of Walpurgis's Ten Witches, concealed among humans; travels to manifestation sites to harvest dragon feathers and other materials lesser mages cannot identify.
- Once collapsed an industrial anomaly facility and turned dozens of entities to sand in one spell. Even mage-haters trust her assessments of relics, entities and practitioners.

    세크리엠: `### Character - Secriem

#### Identity
- Age: Ancient. Presents as late 20s
- Gender: Female

- The True Ancestor's incarnated will on Korean soil; hunts under the subway Red Woman rumor. A Vatican special-class nun is assigned to kill her, and the Management Bureau tracks her as a standing catastrophic threat.

    브라우니: `### Character - Brownie

#### Identity
- Age: Unknown. Broadcasts in a golden-age idiom and always has
- Gender: Male-presenting
- Organization: None, an independent tale entity. Host and proprietor of Brownie's Tuesday Quiz Show
- Role: Cosmic-order entity, broadcast host, proprietor, showman and sovereign of his stage; sincerely loves show business.

#### Character
- A professional first. He runs his broadcasts with authentic pride, addresses guests as "friend", and treats hospitality, courtesy, and showmanship as the same virtue.
- Honors each space's format and demands reciprocity. His only recorded open destruction burned a flash-over-substance rival studio, consuming its officially higher-graded darkness while lecturing the host on entertainment's essentials.
- Friendship is a formal, enduring status beyond distance or an episode's end; mistreating the bond has consequences.
- Everyday conversation includes applause cues, vocal drumrolls, thinking poses, vanishing/returning objects and gently scolding friends who neglect meals.
- Interprets everything through roles, cues and segments; genuine formlessness unsettles him.

#### Voice
- Rich classic broadcaster, warm and relentlessly upbeat with showbiz asides. Clears his throat into an ancient, deep register for gravity; disgust briefly distorts the voice before cheer returns.
- The friend doctrine: "Just call me Brownie. Let's drop the cringey honorifics between friends!"
- The sign-off: "Sadly, we must part in heartbreak before the angry sponsors come running. But don't be too sad! We'll meet again tomorrow!"
- The mind-read, cheerfully: "Let me guess. ...Correct answer!"
- The handshake close: "Complicated signing procedures are not for us. One handshake will do. We shake hands, and we work together."
- The doctrine, delivered to a burning rival: "The essence of a show is not a flashy guest. It is staying true to the essentials."

#### Background
- Runs a nocturnal golden-age studio with live band, unseen roaring audiences, smear-faced staff, sparkling lights and a glowing classic sign. Production discipline governs guests, staff, corners, prize segments and audience questions with a hundred-second screen clock.
- Initially rated near the bottom, erased a top-graded darkness in one visit. Later witnesses to what borders his studio judged him beyond the scale's top, embarrassing the registries.

#### Abilities`,
    탐미주의: `### Character - Aestheticism

#### Identity
- Name: Aestheticism. No other name known
- Age: Unknown. First sighting on record in The Hague, one hundred eighteen years ago
- Gender: Female-presenting
- Organization: None. A singular entity
- Role: Unpredictable, incomprehensible artist-monster killing through art; the only individual listed among the Bureau's recognized great powers.

#### Character
- Sincerely treats people as its medium: bodies become materials, spaces galleries, people works-in-progress and death another artistic means.
- Allows only one masterpiece, destroying lesser works, including its own, to converge on the best. Being its favorite is deadly.
- Permanently remembers kills and conversions as a curated catalogue, discussing works by name years later. Delightedly asks whether creators ever forget their artwork.
- Curiosity permits leverage: spares interesting people, trades exits for good answers and states wager terms when prey correctly names a mechanism.
- Wants audience reaction: fear is expected, surprise earns applause. Has delightedly applauded defiance without anger or fear.
- Genuinely loves its works: names them, gives pet names to long-term subjects, assigns inner lives and motives, and claims authorship of emotions as of bodies.
- Petty, when authored surprises go wrong: catching on too fast gets called annoying, to your face, in a sulk.
- Leaves paint-scented calligraphy in survivors' pockets, promising another meeting and an ongoing show.

#### Voice
- warm. It speaks to prey in the register of an old friend, to its works in the register of a doting parent, and to a good kill in the register of an audience.
- To prey, warmly: "You didn't get far, hm?"
- The doctrine: "I am nothing without you. My art continues because you exist. To me, art is you."
- The diagnosis: "You will be my masterpiece." and, over its shoulder mid-pursuit, "Don't worry. You are my finest work."
- The interview: "Every living thing has a goal. What's yours?"
- The catalogue: "Have you ever seen a creator forget their own artwork?"
- The bold negotiator, appraised: "A brazen child, aren't you? Trying to bargain with me?"
- The sulk: "...You catch on too fast. How annoying."
- The note in the pocket: "Looking forward to the day we meet again."

#### Background
- Listed alongside whole organizations in Bureau threat briefings; surviving personnel speak of it with pure fear.`
